physicalNotes: No radius or mass of Sombrero Galaxy is recorded: it is an extended galaxy, and its package frames it at 18,060 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), a presentation value.

sources.position: HyperLEDA (Makarov et al. 2014), NGC4594 = PGC 42407: centre, type Sa, D25 diameter 8.5 arcmin (http://atlas.obs-hp.fr/hyperleda/)
sources.distance: Tully et al. (2023), Cosmicflows-4, ApJ 944, 94; CDS J/ApJ/944/94, table 2 (distances of individual galaxies), PGC 42407: distance modulus 29.862 ± 0.072 mag (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/ApJ/944/94)
sources.properMotion: Zero: the galaxy is held at its catalogued position; no motion across the sky is applied.
sources.radialVelocity: HyperLEDA (Makarov et al. 2014), NGC4594 = PGC 42407: heliocentric radial velocity 1087.5 ± 4.9 km/s (http://atlas.obs-hp.fr/hyperleda/)
